notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:

[*]Corrected position of after party's loot drops to fit the UI

[list][*]Changed "little that they have" to "Little that they do have"
[*]Changed "to these kids" to "for these kids"[/list]

[b]Label[/b]

[list][*]Added "Healing Spa" label to the door at the Spa
[*]Added "Save Point" label to the crystals[/list]

[b]Lore[/b]

[list][*]Added text to the letter Frosty had been writing to his home
[*]Added a small message if you go all the way across the whole roof of Roaring Caverns[/list]

[b]UI[/b]

[list][*]Names for the actions in battles are now centered[/list]

notes.title: Krampus limited Time Event and Version 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Krampus has arrived to Kemivieska![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39147815/2efe16eb795774bfa4207859e566823a748b8e55.jpg[/img]

If you talk to Krampus, she'll give you Krampus Mask, some money and teach your magical user (Frosty or Jackie Frost, whoever you choose) an Unique spell; Quantum Leap.

[h2]Krampus can be found in Kemivieska until January 1st of 2021. Then she'll leave, only to come back again during the Christmas.[/h2]

[h3]Version 1.2 Patch[/h3]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Timmy could tell a joke when talking to someone else or him, this has been fixed
[*]From the second floor, you could receive a sound effect of opening a chest on the first floor even though the was impossible to open from second floor. This has been fixed to avoid the misleading audio information to the player.
[*]Using Quantum Leap crystal and then returning via return portal made it snow in Roaring Caverns, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Event[/b]

[list][*]Krampus has come to the city of Kemivieska and shall reward you with a Krampus Mask, some money and teaching either Frosty or Jackie Frost an unique spell; Quantum Leap. Krampus will remain until January 1st, then she'll leave until 2021 Christmas.[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]You can now map the controls of Gamepad to your liking
[*]Orphanage lady could block access to the rest of the orphanage, now her pathfinding sticks her to the single room 
[*]Monsters can no longer attack you from the first floor, while you're on the second floor
[*]Jackie Frost now follows you around on the map, if you recruit her[/list]

[b]Grammar[/b]

[list][*]"Hey brother!" changed to "Hey there brother!"[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Reduced the quantity of visual messages of "Inner Sanctum" 
[*]Added a lot more snow across various objects in Kemiveiska including but not limited to; Windows, bridges and plants
[*]Changed the water at Kemivieska to a more suitable snow edged water[/list]

[b]Lore[/b]

[list][*]Renamed generic "House" as "Frosty's Home"[/list]

[b]Mapping [/b]

[list][*]Added blocking objects in Kemivieska to allow future content become accessible later in the game's lifespan[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Changed the Skills U[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.12
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]

[list][*]Lowered Blizzard's damage to 2 times Wisdom (was 3)[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Getting haircut could cause screen to stay black, this has been fixed
[*]Talking to Molly again after giving her cocoa had missing voice lines, this has been fixed
[*]Bath attendant had wrong boolean check and didn't play her voice lines, this has been fixed
[*]You could walk on a certain specific spot at wall in the Banquet Hall, this has been fixed
[*]You could see a present that had been claimed in second floor of Roaring Caverns, this has been fixed
[*]Having haircut DLC active had the voice acting missing when checking out orphanage's money, this has been fixed
[*]You could interact with a lever from second floor of ice cave to flip it multiple times, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]The game now has after battle victory  party[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.11
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Resetting the sleigh ride minigame didn't reset score counter, allowing impossibly high scores that could potentially even break the game. This has been fixed.
[*]Replacement Santa achievement didn't unlock in some situations, this has been fixed[/list]
